Millionaire for Life Results

You could be a jackpot winner, right now! Here's where you can find the latest Millionaire for Life results.

The Millionaire for Life draw is held every night. Are you holding the lucky ticket? It's time to find out.

Are you a winner?

To bring home the jackpot, you will need to match all five main numbers plus the Millionaire Ball.

If you haven't matched all the numbers, you may still have won a prize. Even if you only match one main number and the Millionaire Ball you still win a prize!

We'll let you know via email if you have won a prize in the Millionaire for Life lottery draw.

Draws are conducted every day at 11.15pm Eastern Time.
